title: Mario Party 7: MC Edition - Resource Pack
description: This resource pack customizes the main menu's panoramic background, the button text, records, and more!
body:
Hey guys! Thank you so much for wanting to find out more about this resource pack I've made! Here's what it changes:

- Some items, blocks, and the Squid
  - Eventually most of these changes will be removed when I completely finish making my map and will be applied to my Mario Party 7 Minecraft Edition mod instead.
- Title Screen and some button text.
  - This resource pack becomes unblurred (not the best looking, but better visible) in 1.12.2 using Optifine's layout in the assets folder when using Optifine.
- All the records have been replaced with most of Mario Party 7's Main Menu and Gameboard music.
- When going underwater, you won't have the underwater overlay in your face.

Side Note: I am using Complementary Unbound 5.1.1's shader pack in all of my screenshots if Minecraft looks a bit different than usual.

If you haven't already checked it out, go take a look at my [Mario Party 7: Minecraft Edition map](https://www.planetminecraft.com/project/mario-party-7-minecraft-edition/) and my mod! I have the mod uploaded here on Modrinth and on my Planet Minecraft page.

Regarding the versions of Minecraft this will work on: Modrinth **_automatically_** chose them, but if it does NOT work on a specific version that it currently is listed to work with, **please** let me know and I will manually update it.
